saathiReport:
All nine steps are implemented, verified and committed on `integration/delivery` in `C:\Users\jaina\Downloads\pyaas-saathi` (nothing pushed). Final state: `flutter analyze` clean, `flutter test` 90 pass (baseline 59; 31 added, none removed).

## Commits (oldest first), each with analyze/test at that point

| Step | Commit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Item adjust keyed by product id | `02f34db` | clean / 63 pass |
| 2. New-order snack diffs task ids | `92042b6` | clean / 69 pass |
| 3. Structured door + morning-round grouping | `51e4936` | clean / 77 pass |
| 4. `geoExact` fence (C3) | `8f31455` | clean / 80 pass |
| 5. Cash OTP manual path | `4deb0fa` | clean / 84 pass |
| 6. `DROP` handover | `5f19ffb` | clean / 86 pass |
| 7. Upcoming days from `/upcoming` (C1) | `ef41d7b` | clean / 90 pass |
| 8. Dead rider calls removed | `0bf6f8b` | clean / 90 pass |
| 9. Stale catalog comment | `61118c4` | clean / 90 pass |
| ASCII header follow-up to step 8 | `ba5fc5d` | clean / 90 pass |

## What each step does

1. **`lib/models/store.dart`** gains `DeliveryItem.adjustKey` (product id, else `name|variant`). **`store_order_screen.dart`** keys every stepper and the pending-edit map by it; **`store_api.dart`** sends `{product_id, variant, name, qty}` per changed line via `adjustItemsWire`. Wire `name` stays verbatim. Widget test proves reducing Gold 500ml sends one line and leaves Gold 1L untouched, with and without a product id.
2. **`store_home.dart`**: `newOrderCount(seen, orders)` counts unfinished ids not in the accumulated seen-set; a task ageing out on the same poll no longer hides a new order (tested).
3. `DeliveryTask` and `StoreOrder` read `society`, `societyId`/`society_id`, `tower`, `floor`, `unit`. New `lib/widgets/door_line.dart` renders "Tower B, Floor 7, Flat 704" (mirrors the consumer capture form; Hindi keys added) beside the address on the rider card and detail and the store card and detail. `RiderStore.groupByDoor` groups `morningWaiting` by society, then tower, then floor, each group taking its earliest stop's slot, due-time then task-id order untouched inside; a stop with no society id stays put. Tests for parsing, grouping order, stability across polls, and card rendering.
4. `DeliveryTask.geoExact` is tri-state (`geoExact`/`geo_exact`). The swipe screen blocks on distance only when it is `true`; `false` or absent measures and reports but never blocks and never shows "too far". `geofence_ok` goes as `true` in that case because the backend rejects `false` outright (`delivery_svc.go:767`) and measures its own fence only for `GeoExact`. The existing far-from-door test now declares `geoExact: true`; two new cases cover `false` and absent.
5. `_CollectSheet` is now public `CollectCashSheet` with `requestOtp`/`collect` seams. On `OTP_UNAVAILABLE`, 422 or any 5xx it shows a plain notice, keeps a retry, and enables "Confirm without OTP" (the collect call already omits an empty otp). Other failures keep the gate. Four widget tests.
6. `case 'DROP' || 'LEAVE_AT_DOOR'` share "Leave at the door", no warning; a real do-not-ring beside DROP still shows. `RING_BELL` was left as-is (the bell line already covers it via `ring_bell`).
7. `StoreConsoleApi.upcoming(storeId)` and `parseUpcomingRows` (C1, snake_case); 404/405/501 return `[]` so the section keeps its existing empty note; other failures keep the last answer and never touch the orders tab. Rows render read-only under the existing "Upcoming days" header (no assign/swipe/tap), fetched best-effort after each orders load, honouring the search box. Parser tested against the C1 shape.
8. Removed `sendDeliveryOtp`, `verifyDeliveryOtp`, `submitScan`, `saveDoorPhoto`, `complianceSteps`, `kDefaultComplianceSteps` (grep confirmed zero callers in `lib/`); `undoDelivery` kept with its one caller.
9. Header comment rewritten; `DeliveryItem.label` unchanged and still tested.

## Things to know

- Before every commit I grepped both frontends for each touched route/field; the only hits for the removed routes were the unrelated `/auth/otp/verify`. Nothing existing was renamed or removed on the wire; all changes are additive reads or new routes.
- Two restructured lines keep the pre-existing `' · '` separator (`order_card.dart`, `store_home.dart`) so existing rendering does not change; everything I authored is ASCII. Hindi values in `hi.json` are translation data.
- `analysis_options.yaml` had an uncommitted local change before I started (excludes `build/**` and `android/**`); I left it untracked-in-commits and did not touch it.
- The legacy `lib/screens/delivery/delivery_order_screen.dart` also fences on distance, but `home_router.dart` confirms it is not routed, so I left it alone.
- The pre-existing `warnIfMissed` drag warnings in `rider_delivery_ui_test.dart` (SwipeAction group) print in the baseline too; they are warnings, not failures.

C1 GET /api/v1/consumer/stores/{storeId}/upcoming. Backend (parag-saathi-be integration/delivery, internal/modules/consumer/upcoming.go + module.go:328): route registered in the STORE_MANAGER group directly beside /stores/{storeId}/orders; upcomingRow json tags order_id, delivery_date, delivery_window, lane, consumer_name, phone, address_label, address_text, society, society_id, tower, floor (*int -> number|null), unit, items[{product_id,name,variant,qty}], source in {subscription_preview, scheduled_order}; every key always present; read-only (skips orders that already have a task). Saathi consumer: StoreConsoleApi.upcoming() GETs '/consumer/stores/$storeId/upcoming' on base '.../api/v1' (config.dart) = exact path; UpcomingRow.fromWire reads each snake_case key first (camelCase fallback): order_id, delivery_date, delivery_window, lane (lowercased), consumer_name ('Customer' default), phone, address_label, address_text, society, society_id, tower, floor (toString, so 7 or null both fine), unit, items via DeliveryItem.fromWire (product_id|productId, name, variant, qty|quantity), source (lowercased). Absence tolerated: ApiException status 404/405/501 -> [] (ApiClient sets status from the HTTP code even on a plain-text body: ApiException(status,'HTTP_$status',...)), any other error rethrown and swallowed by _loadUpcoming, which keeps the last answer and never touches _orders/_error. Rows render read-only under the existing "Upcoming days" header (no InkWell, no assign, no swipe), count added to the header, search box honoured, empty-state logic extended. Parser tested field-by-field against the C1 row plus {items} envelope, garbage/id-less rows, null/'nope'/{}. Only nit: _loadUpcoming has no _epoch guard, identical to the pre-existing _loadRiderNames pattern, so not a regression.

C3 task wire geoExact/societyId. Backend delivery.go: GeoExact bool json:"geoExact" (always present), SocietyID json:"societyId,omitempty", plus society/tower/floor(*int)/unit omitempty; server enforces the fence only when d.GeoExact (delivery_svc.go:797-812: rejects geofence_ok=false, then measures its own 300 m only for GeoExact). Saathi DeliveryTask reads geoExact ?? geo_exact through _tri (bool or 'true'/'false' -> bool?, anything else null) and societyId ?? society_id, tower/floor/unit via _sOrNull (floor 0 -> "0", tested). Absence: geoExact null -> _fenced=false -> the fix is still measured and sent with geofence_ok=true, no block, no "too far"/"Move closer" (tested for false and absent; the far-from-door blocking test now declares geoExact:true); societyId null -> stop is its own group and stays in due order (tested). StoreOrder mirrors society/societyId/tower/floor/unit for the store console. Consumed exactly, camelCase first.

C2, C4, C5, C6: consumer-app/backend contracts; Saathi sends/reads none of them. Saathi proof photos go through its own POST /uploads/presign -> B2 and store the backend view_url (storage_api.dart), not a file:// path, so C4 does not apply here.

Other review points: (3) No wire name decorated: DeliveryItem.name stays verbatim, adjustItemsWire sends it.name untouched, size travels only in variant; StoreSku.matches() and canon() in deriveStock are byte-identical across 6348c5e..HEAD (the models/store.dart diff adds only adjustKey and the doc comment; the uncommitted layer adds `implements PackItem` + @override, still no change to matches/canon); DeliveryItem.label unchanged and still tested. Only non-ASCII additions in committed lib/test are two moved pre-existing ' · ' joins. (4) adjustItemsWire -> {product_id, variant, name, qty} per changed line; backend adjustKey prefers id:product_id, then nv:name|variant, then n:name, which is exactly the app's DeliveryItem.adjustKey (productId else name|variant); widget test 'reducing one pack size sends only that line, by product id' (Gold 500ml 2->1 sends one line productId gold-500, the gold-1l line does not travel) plus the no-product-id variant, both executed in the run. (5) Stage list: all 9 steps are present as commits; the backend handoff's "Still open in this repo" items 2-5 are all covered (item 1 is "cut a build"); RING_BELL intentionally left (see regressions). DeliveryOrderScreen (legacy) is only referenced from delivery_home.dart, and home_router.dart no longer imports DeliveryHome, so it is unreachable as reported.
regressions: Geofence goes OFF against the currently deployed backend: the app now blocks only when geoExact == true, and the pre-C3 backend never measured the fence itself (delivery_svc.go comment: it stored proof_distance_m but never looked at it) and only rejects geofence_ok=false. A Saathi build from this branch talking to the deployed backend therefore sends geofence_ok=true from anywhere and no fence exists at all, whereas release/26.07.03 fenced on the phone. Either the deploy order must state backend-C3-first, or the app should keep the old fence when the flag is ABSENT and relax only on an explicit false (the safer additive reading of C3).

Concurrent uncommitted layer in the same working tree (pack_item.dart, pack_lines.dart, store/widgets/store_order_cards.dart, test/pack_volume_test.dart, test/e2e/, tool/e2e/, plus edits to delivery_api.dart, models/store.dart, delivery_order_screen.dart, deliver_swipe_screen.dart, order_detail_screen.dart, order_card.dart, store_home.dart, store_order_screen.dart): it changes rendered text ('×' -> 'x' on both detail screens) and replaces the item summary on the rider card, offer card and store card with a per-line PackLines layout, none of which is on the stage list or in the report; its two new test files were added after my run and are unverified. If it is committed without its own analyze/test pass it invalidates the 'verified after every step' property.

LOW: cash sheet classifies ANY 5xx from POST .../cash/{id}/otp as 'OTP unavailable'. Backend drops the challenge on OTP_UNAVAILABLE and on SMS-send failure, but a gateway timeout after the SMS actually went out leaves a live challenge, so 'Confirm without OTP' answers 400 OTP_REQUIRED and the sheet shows no OTP box; the rider must wait out the resend cooldown (429 keeps the gate) and retry. Not stuck, but the copy is wrong for that case.

LOW: handover RING_BELL has no line of its own in DeliveryPrefsView; today it is harmless because the consumer app only sends RING_BELL together with ring_bell:true (cart.tsx:344), which prints 'Ring the bell'. A task carrying RING_BELL with ring_bell unset would show no handover line.
left_undone: The uncommitted concurrent layer listed above needs a decision: commit it as its own step with a fresh analyze/test run (including test/pack_volume_test.dart and the SAATHI_E2E-gated e2e file), or set it aside. It is not part of the reviewed 10 commits.

Deploy-order note for C3 (backend before this Saathi build) is not written anywhere in this repo; HANDOFF-CODEV-2026-09-20.md still says 'flutter test 59 pass' and lists items 2-5 as open although they are now done.

Legacy lib/screens/delivery/delivery_order_screen.dart still maps only LEAVE_AT_DOOR/LEAVE_WITH_GUARD (no DROP) and fences unconditionally; unreachable (home_router.dart does not import DeliveryHome), left alone as reported.
ComplianceStep model class in lib/models/rider.dart is orphaned after step 8 removed its only consumer; harmless dead code.

Pre-existing local persistence in Saathi outside this change set, if the 'nothing local but the cart' rule is meant to apply to Saathi too: PourOutbox offline pour queue in lib/api/collection_api.dart (SharedPreferences), record_pour_sheet.dart drafts, delivery_event_id.dart idempotency keys (needed for exactly-once debit), language pref in l10n.dart, session tokens in secure storage.
